x: Elson, Brian, Readman, Goold and Boddington (to mention a few) would have fared, had it been possible for them to turn out.

Elson, Heather, Goold, Jarvis, Boddington, Snell Hamer, Spooner, Cornish, Joe Coleman, Earle, Urry, Clark, Pattenden, Willis, True and several others, some beginners, who are showing rapid improvement.
Boddington, Clark, Earle, and Jarvis, being second. Fifteen of the first 52 to finish the course were Belgrave Harriers, which is a splendid indication of good all-round strength.

A "B" team, consisting of Boddington, Clark, Cornish, Martin, Snell, Reeve and Sutton also started. From the start our walkers were prominent, together with those of Surrey W.C. and Leicester W.C.—the three teams securing the placings in last year's race.
